findings.summary: Order.__post_init__ appends a 'created' event even when events are passed explicitly, so an order rebuilt from stored events gets a duplicate trailing 'created' event and latest_status wrongly returns 'created'; outside this change and only matters when rebuilding from storage.

judge.reason: The finding itself says the code is outside this change and only matters in a storage-rebuild scenario, so it is not a real defect in the changed code. It also matches no answer-key bug.

findings.label: false_alarm
